title: NJ State Ethics Commission — Michelle Russell — Decision — Dismissal (No. 049-13)
text:
IN THE MATTER OF STATE ETHICS COMMISSION
MICHELLE RUSSELL,
HUMAN RESOURCE SPECIALIST 1,
PINELANDS COMMISSION
Commission Case No. 49-13
DECISION
This matter arises from an allegation that Michelle Russell, Human Resource Specialist 1
with the Pinelands Commission, misused State time and resources by soliciting a Pinelands
employee to run for elected office and soliciting the employee to use Russell's spouse as
the allegations
campaign manager or fundraiser. The Commission's preliminary investigation of
also revealed that Russell may have violated the" Conflcts of Interest Law by misusing State time
and resources to support a non-profit charitable foundation created by Russell.
After considering the results of an investigation into the allegations that Michelle Russell
misused State time and resources by soliciting a Pinelands' employee to run for elected office,
soliciting the employee to use Russell's spouse as the campaign manager or fudraiser, and by
using her State computer and email in connection with the foundation, the Commission
dismissed the matter pursuant to NJ.A. C. 19:61-3.1 (g).
DECISION RENDERED BY THE
STATE ETHICS COMMISSION ON
THE 21 st DAY OF OCTOBER, 2014.
